label: 列车窗边回眸：午后暖色逆光 + 蓝色座椅车厢，50mm 柔焦胶片感

subject.description: an adult East Asian woman with a slender, soft oval face, a small chin, natural dark eyes, slender eyebrows, a small nose, subtly glossy lips, and very natural makeup over real fine skin texture
subject.pose: as she sits sideways by the window of a moving train, her shoulders and upper body angled two-thirds away from the camera toward frame right, her head turned gently back toward the lens in a natural over-the-shoulder glance, her legs extending toward frame right
subject.expression: a quiet, restrained, slightly aloof expression
subject.wardrobe: an ivory-champagne satin thin-strap camisole with delicate but restrained lace trim at the neckline, and a loose white semi-sheer satin robe slipped down from both shoulders — the shoulder nearer the camera left bare, the sleeves loosely bunched around her arms — the satin showing a soft pearlescent sheen, not plastic or metallic

sections.heading: Hair
sections.body: long, dense dark brown-black hair falls naturally over her chest and waist, a heavy sweep of strands covering one side of her face, side-swept bangs partially veiling one eye, slightly tousled with real airborne flyaways.

camera.position: at her seated eye level from the aisle side, facing her two-thirds side profile
camera.framing: subject occupies about 55% of the frame in the left foreground, cropped at mid-thigh with only part of her thighs visible

light.key: Warm late-afternoon sunlight slanting through the train window from her back-left at about 135 degrees, strong but soft backlight forming a golden rim through her hair, with slight overexposure glow and halation near the window
light.fill: soft ambient bounce keeping her face gently lit and readable

background: a softly blurred train carriage with clearly recognizable blue fabric seats, a few passengers behind her toward frame right — a woman in light clothing and a man in a dark jacket — present only as silhouettes with unreadable faces
fingerprints: faint reflections and hazy glare on the window glass
a fold-down tray table on the seat back ahead
an overhead luggage rack dissolving into the blur
atmosphere: a quiet mid-journey moment that feels accidentally captured rather than posed, Japanese film portrait mood
quality: natural skin texture with visible fine detail
shallow depth of field focused on her eyes and face
soft-focus lens with a subtle diffusion filter and reduced digital sharpness
creamy highlight bloom and dreamy halation
warm white balance and soft low contrast
negative: neatly pressed hair fully revealing both eyes
the robe worn neatly in place
